text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's no good. How am I even
supposed to
practice being sincere?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that reminds me of the advice
Tamamo
Cross gave her when they were
discussing what to
get Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So Narita Taishin's going to repay Super
Creek's
kindness by expressing her
feelings more
sincerely? That's pretty
commendable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you butting in for? This
has
nothing to do with—wait, were you

eavesdropping on me?
choice_data_list: その練習、手伝えないかな？

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A-as if! Ugh, you're so... I mean, really!
choice_data_list: ごめん、悩んでるみたいだったから

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fine! So what if I was struggling? You
actually
gonna help me out or
something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so you want to be more sincere...
That
could be quite the endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: H-her best friends? Like, BEST friends?! Taishin thinks we're besties?! Waaah, I'm so happy! Ohhh, Taishiiin!
choice_data_list: まずは1番の仲良しが相手にいいと思って

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, shut it already! Let's just get this
over with!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Expressing yourself is a part of being
sincere. So
to help you with that, I
consulted several quiz
books and came
up with...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Answer in Earnest: Hayahide's Special
True or
False Quiz!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin. Question number one—true
or false?
You have previously attempted
to eat an entire
extra-large serving of
the cafeteria's daily special.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean, I was hungry...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mhm... Challenging yourself is important, but you mustn't push your limits too hard. Next time you take on such a task, invite me along too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Question number two—true or false?
You tend to
schedule your training
sessions for when there
aren't many
people around.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, there's nothing wrong with that,
but you'd
be at greater risk if you got
into an accident.
Always know when to
ask others for help. Next...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec. How many more of these
annoying
"life lessons" of yours do I have
to listen to?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Okay, my turn! Ta-dah! Check it out—it's
a cat
cafe!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because, get this... Taishin really wants
to talk to
cats!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you on about?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're not fooling me! I saw you hanging
out with
your feline friend in that
shopping district alley!
You had a whole
conversation and everything!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wha—?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But you went quiet when people came
around! I
think it'd be good for you to
get comfy talking to
kitties even when
others are watching!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you saw me?! Hang on, that wasn't—I
was just
talking to myself, not the cat!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nnngh!
choice_data_list: 素直な気持ちで答えて

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's right. If you're going to chat with
a cat, you
have do it with an honest and
open heart!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: An honest and open heart...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Forget this! It's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can be more sincere or
open or
whatever! It's seriously making
my skin crawl!
Dummies!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It seems you've finally revealed
the true
feelings hidden in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did it ever feel like Creek was forcing
herself to
help you? Or going out of her
way?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they looked a little worn, and you
might hurt
yourself if they ripped, so I
mended them!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This is a super important time for me too, and I want us both to keep training and working hard! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I get it now... I just have to be honest
with her...
That's all there is to it.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hang on. If you already knew what I
needed to
do, why'd you make me jump
through so many
hoops?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I meeean, it's not every day we get to
see you
being honest! We couldn't resist!
Right,
Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Grrr! You two are SO dead!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Grrr! You two are SO dead!
choice_data_list: 今度は2人に素直になってもらおう！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
With friends like these... Ugh! First they
play me
like a fiddle, then they rub in
the salt!
choice_data_list: 今度は2人に素直になってもらおう！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... I guess they helped a little.
choice_data_list: でも、おかげで気づけたこともあるよな？
でも、おかげで気づけたこともあるよね？

text_block_list.name: Hayahide and Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But only a little! You barely even helped
at all!
Geez...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice idea...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with you, Hayahide. Question
number
one—and remember, be sincere.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
True or false? You think your hair looks
good
today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Wait, are you saying it doesn't look good?!
